sections.Overview:
Gold rush chaos. Avalanche multiball. One very mischievous Yeti.
Stampede into the Yukon in search of fortune, battle rapids and avalanches, outwit Soapy Smith, survive the climb to Chilkoot Pass, and raid Yukon Yeti’s hidden stash in a wild pinball adventure inspired by the Klondike Gold Rush.
Legendary Edition™ is available now and is estimated to begin shipping in Summer 2026. A $2,000 deposit is required. See reservation terms and FAQ below for details.
Plus tax and shipping/handling if applicable.
Legendary Edition™ includes an icy white powder coat, a 5-ball avalanche lock mech, detailed hand-painted playfield sculpts, and the core Yukon Yeti™ experience. Upgrade options are listed below.
Yukon Yeti™ Legendary Edition™ pictured with some optional upgrades.
sections.A Legendary Audio Designer Returns to Pi:
We’re excited to announce that Chris Granner is joining Yukon Yeti™ to lead its sound direction. After more than 20 years in video games, he returns to pinball for a project that reconnects him with the style and spirit that made his earlier work iconic.
Chris Granner is a renowned audio designer and composer whose work helped define the sound of modern pinball. After his influential contributions to the industry, he spent over two decades in video game audio, bringing his talent to a wide range of successful titles. His return to pinball brings a rare blend of legacy and experience to Yukon Yeti™.
Adam Gubman joins the project as composer and sound designer. A longtime collaborator with Chris, Adam brings a cinematic, modern approach to game audio. While Chris leads audio direction, Adam helps drive composition and implementation to deliver a fresh experience that builds on a classic foundation.

sections.Gameplay Highlights:
Yukon Yeti™ is structured around gathering supplies, surviving the climb north, staking a claim, battling Soapy Smith, and ultimately facing Yukon Yeti himself.
The first major objective is building up the provisions needed for the journey, echoing the real Yukon rush requirement of bringing a year’s worth of supplies.
Win big at Soapy’s Saloon, see Klondike Kate’s show, survive a town fire, and settle the score in a showdown with Soapy and his gang.
Climb Chilkoot Trail, trigger Avalanche Multiball, build a boat, and survive the White Horse Rapids.
Stake your claim, mine deep and wide, fend off Yeti sabotage, and cash in at the Trading Post for special rewards.
The Yeti is woven through the game as prankster, thief, gatekeeper, and final adversary, culminating in his secret stash.
The rules include hurry-ups, treasure-map progression, multiballs, jackpot building, supplies, gold nuggets, and multiple wizard modes.

sections.FAQ:
Please review the terms and conditions for purchase and reach out with any questions before placing a deposit.
When will Yukon Yeti™ ship? + Yukon Yeti™ is currently expected to begin shipping in Summer 2026. Our current production capacity is about 240 games per year. We are building a new shop, which we expect to be completed within 12 months that will increase this capacity. We anticipate fulfilling 500 orders of Yukon Yeti within 18-24 months. What is the price and deposit? + Legendary Edition™ is $9,999 with a required $2,000 deposit. How many units will be made? + We will produce 500 Legendary Edition™ Yukon Yeti™ machines before moving on to our next title. We have no current plans to produce any other edition of this game, but we will not rule out the possibility. On the remote chance it were to happen, it would be far in the future, be distinct from the current offering, and we would not anticipate any impact on the current buyers. What comes standard? + The base game includes an icy white powder coat, a 5-ball avalanche lock mech, and detailed hand-painted playfield sculpts.
